config.name: Aircraft by altitude band
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS bucket,
       substring(multiIf(grounded, '1 ground', altitude IS NULL, '0 unknown', altitude < 10000, '2 0-10k ft', altitude < 20000, '3 10-20k ft', altitude < 30000, '4 20-30k ft', '5 30k+ ft'), 3) AS band,
       uniqExact(hex) AS aircraft
FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       upper(toString(_json.hex)) AS hex,
       if(match(trimBoth(toString(_json.flight)), '^[A-Z0-9 ]+$'), trimBoth(toString(_json.flight)), upper(toString(_json.hex))) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lat)) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lon)) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.track)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.gs)) AS speed,
       toString(_json.alt_baro) = 'ground' AS grounded,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.alt_baro)) AS altitude,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.baro_rate)) AS rate,
       toString(_json.t) AS type
FROM dfe.`adsb-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
GROUP BY bucket, multiIf(grounded, '1 ground', altitude IS NULL, '0 unknown', altitude < 10000, '2 0-10k ft', altitude < 20000, '3 10-20k ft', altitude < 30000, '4 20-30k ft', '5 30k+ ft')
ORDER BY bucket, multiIf(grounded, '1 ground', altitude IS NULL, '0 unknown', altitude < 10000, '2 0-10k ft', altitude < 20000, '3 10-20k ft', altitude < 30000, '4 20-30k ft', '5 30k+ ft')

config.name: Altitude bands now
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT substring(band, 3) AS "Band",
       count() AS "Aircraft",
       round(avg(speed)) AS "Average speed (kn)"
FROM (
  SELECT hex, argMax(multiIf(grounded, '1 ground', altitude IS NULL, '0 unknown', altitude < 10000, '2 0-10k ft', altitude < 20000, '3 10-20k ft', altitude < 30000, '4 20-30k ft', '5 30k+ ft'), ts) AS band, argMax(speed, ts) AS speed
  FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       upper(toString(_json.hex)) AS hex,
       if(match(trimBoth(toString(_json.flight)), '^[A-Z0-9 ]+$'), trimBoth(toString(_json.flight)), upper(toString(_json.hex))) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lat)) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lon)) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.track)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.gs)) AS speed,
       toString(_json.alt_baro) = 'ground' AS grounded,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.alt_baro)) AS altitude,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.baro_rate)) AS rate,
       toString(_json.t) AS type
FROM dfe.`adsb-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
  WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 6 MINUTE
  GROUP BY hex
)
GROUP BY band
ORDER BY band

config.name: Climbing and descending now
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT track AS "Callsign",
       argMax(type, ts) AS "Type",
       argMax(altitude, ts) AS "Altitude (ft)",
       argMax(rate, ts) AS "Climb rate (ft/min)",
       round(argMax(speed, ts)) AS "Speed (kn)"
FROM (SELECT _timestamp AS ts,
       upper(toString(_json.hex)) AS hex,
       if(match(trimBoth(toString(_json.flight)), '^[A-Z0-9 ]+$'), trimBoth(toString(_json.flight)), upper(toString(_json.hex))) AS track,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lat)) AS lat,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.lon)) AS lon,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.track)) AS heading,
       toFloat64OrNull(toString(_json.gs)) AS speed,
       toString(_json.alt_baro) = 'ground' AS grounded,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.alt_baro)) AS altitude,
       toInt32OrNull(toString(_json.baro_rate)) AS rate,
       toString(_json.t) AS type
FROM dfe.`adsb-tracks`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL 6 MINUTE AND NOT grounded
GROUP BY track
HAVING abs("Climb rate (ft/min)") >= 500
ORDER BY abs("Climb rate (ft/min)") DESC
LIMIT 20
